name: Now playing
description: What your Mac is playing, in the sidebar and on a page: the cover, the song and artist, how far in, play, pause, skip and shuffle, and the volume. Works with any app that tells macOS what it plays (Spotify, Music, a browser tab). Only on the Mac the app's server runs on.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: What the user's Mac is playing, and play, pause, skip or volume: `now-playing.get`, `now-playing.control`.

now-playing.description: what this mac is playing, with its cover, position, controls and volume
now-playing.live: macOS's now playing (MediaRemote) on the server's machine
